description: The image displays a 2x2 grid of four pie charts representing the distribution of language model answer refusal categories across four different models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. None of the charts utilize an external legend; instead, all category labels, absolute counts, and percentage values are presented as text directly inside their corresponding slices. There are no exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized segments, and the slices do not appear to follow a strict size-based sorting order. The top-left chart for GPT4-o contains two slices: a predominantly large red slice labeled "Lack of Knowledge" with 5 counts (83.3%) and a smaller orange slice labeled "Safety" with 1 count (16.7%). The top-right chart for Gemini1.5-Pro is the most complex, containing five distinct slices: an orange slice for "Misinformation" with 33 counts (38.4%), a dark blue slice for "Lack of Knowledge" with 19 counts (22.1%), a light blue slice for "Ethical Advice" with 14 counts (16.3%), a light yellow slice for "Clarification" with 12 counts (14.0%), and a red slice for "Safety" with 8 counts (9.3%). The bottom-left chart for Llama3.1-70B-Instruct contains two slices: a large orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" showing 3 counts (75.0%) and a smaller red slice for "Clarification" showing 1 count (25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct is evenly divided into two slices: a red right-half segment labeled "Misinformation" with 2 counts (50.0%) and an orange left-half segment labeled "Lack of Knowledge" with 2 counts (50.0%).
